name: Sort It
goal: Put each item in the right box. The sign says how.
tip: Check the sign first, then look only at that one thing: the colour, or the type.
voice: An item will appear in the middle.
Tap the box it belongs in, as quickly as you can.
The sign at the top tells you how to sort: by colour, or by type.
Watch the sign. Sometimes it changes.
check_sign: Check the sign, then try the next one
